title: Pre-Analysis — Release of the Low-Temperature Cure Adhesive Bonding Process
abstract: Pre-analysis of the low-temperature cure bonding process release, covering the repair schemes that would gain it, the standard practice that has to carry it and the boundary with primary structure.

sections.objective: The process is a release rather than an embodiment, so the round was asked a different question from the usual one: which published repair schemes could use the low-temperature system on the day it is released, which of them must not, and where the boundary is written down so that a repair organisation cannot cross it by accident.
sections.findings_summary: Three items were confirmed and the release was recommended, but the sequencing was handed to the materials and processes group because the certification review is not closed. The standard practice task is the only place the surface preparation, the bond line control and the coupon evidence live, and it must carry the new system before any scheme can call it up. The wing lower cover repair is the scheme that gains most, because its current cure needs a heater blanket on a thin skin at the limit of what a line team can control, and it uses the process reference washer that the practice controls. The boundary with primary structure is stated in the modification text and nowhere in the published set, which is the gap that matters: a repair organisation reading only the standard practice would not see it.
sections.next_steps: Write the primary structure exclusion into the standard practice task, not only into the modification. Sequence the release of the repair schemes behind the certification review. Hand the release plan to materials and processes with the scheme list attached.

expected_findings.rationale: The standard practice is the only place the surface preparation, the bond line control and the coupon evidence live. It must carry the new system before any repair scheme can call it up, and it does not state the primary structure exclusion.
expected_findings.resolution: Write the exclusion and the new system into the standard practice task.

expected_findings.rationale: The wing lower cover repair gains most from the new system because its current cure needs a heater blanket on thin skin at the limit of line control, and it uses the process reference article the practice controls.
expected_findings.resolution: Sequence this scheme first once the certification review is closed.

evidence.similarity_note: Both texts describe releasing a qualified surface process for metallic structure and both talk about protection schemes and bare material, but they share no part number, no drawing and no zone.

expected_findings.rationale: The chromate-free surface protection standard is the closest thing in the published set to a process release of this kind and its release plan is a useful precedent, but it touches nothing this process changes.
expected_findings.resolution: No action beyond using its release plan as a template.

type_data.conclusion: Closed by delegation to materials and processes. The finding that mattered was that the primary structure exclusion exists only in the modification dossier and not in the practice a repair organisation actually reads.
